what: Post-edit `git grep` is repo-wide and will still match committed `larch-logs/` review artifacts
scenario_or_breakage: The verification step claims only `CHANGELOG.md` should match, but `larch-logs/implement/**` already contains many historical references to both harness names; a literal `git grep -nE 'test-report-tokens-recompute|test-rate-assertions'` will fail or block the implementer even when all live surfaces are clean
suggested_fix: Scope the check, e.g. `git grep -nE 'test-report-tokens-recompute|test-rate-assertions' -- Makefile agent-lint.toml docs/linting.md skills/report-tokens CHANGELOG.md` and expect matches only in `CHANGELOG.md` (historical line ~2107 plus the new `### Removed` bullet), or add `':!larch-logs'`
